build_rotation_matrix: build a 4x4 rotation matrix from an angle, direction vector, and optional pivot point using rotation_matrix
create_euler_matrix: create a homogeneous rotation matrix from Euler roll, pitch, yaw angles with a specified axis sequence using euler_matrix
convert_quaternion_to_matrix: convert a quaternion [x, y, z, w] into a 4x4 homogeneous rotation matrix using quaternion_matrix
decompose_transformation_matrix: decompose a 4x4 transformation matrix into scale, shear, Euler angles, translation, and perspective components using decompose_matrix
compose_transformation_matrix: compose a 4x4 transformation matrix from scale, shear, Euler angles, translation, and perspective using compose_matrix
